newsitem.title: UK: Tabloids hail Blair with identical headlines.
newsitem.headline: Tabloids hail Blair with identical headlines.

text.p: - Britain's two leading tabloid newspapers -- arch-rivals The Mirror and The Sun -- on Friday celebrated Labour leader Tony Blair's apparent election victory with identical headlines.
"Sealed with a X" was the banner headline that dominated the front pages of both papers, which also carried identical pictures of Blair's wife Cherie kissing him.
The Mirror has been a long-time Labour supporter. The Sun, owned by media magnate Rupert Murdoch, recently converted to Blair's cause after supporting Prime Minister John Major in the 1992 election.
